csv_project_name: GC/CM for W200 Duwamish River Crossing & Aerial Guideway
csv_scope_of_work: General Contractor/Construction Manager (GC/CM) Services for the construction of the W200 Duwamish River Crossing & Aerial Guideway ( Project ). This Project consists of services for the construction of a cable stayed bridge spanning the west navigable channel of the Duwamish River, long span and regular span elevated guideway installations through the dense, highly industrial SODO neighborhood, and retained cut guideway installation at an environmentally critical steep slope area within proximity to the existing West Seattle Bridge. The Project is generally located in Seattle, WA between the SODO area and the future Delridge Station.
